channel.title: Secrets on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Secrets on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Secret
item.description: This section describes how to create a Secret. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project Management permissions and enter your federated project.

item.title: View Secret List
item.description: This section describes how to view the Secret list. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project View permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project View permissions and enter your federated project.

item.title: View Secret Details
item.description: This section describes how to view Secret details. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project View permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project View permissions and enter your federated project.

item.title: Edit Secret Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit Secret information. You can edit the alias and description of a Secret. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a Secret. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace.

item.title: Edit Secret Settings
item.description: This section describes how to edit the settings of a Secret. You can edit the data of a Secret. KubeSphere does not support editing the type of a Secret. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace.

item.title: Delete Secret
item.description: This section describes how to delete a Secret. Warning A Secret cannot be recovered after deletion. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace.
